name: Adaptive PID-Lag with asymmetric advantage
tagline: PID Lagrangian targeting 80% of the cost limit, with violation-quadratic gain scheduling, anti-windup integral, predictive lookahead, and 1.5x cost penalty on cost-increasing actions.
init_recovers: PID-Lag baseline at violation_ratio=0 and asymmetry=0
diff_from_baseline: Extends the pid_lag baseline with violation-quadratic gain scheduling targeting 80% of the cost limit, asymmetric integral (fast up, slow down), a predictive trend term, and an asymmetric cost-advantage combination.

name: Adaptive-step-size Lagrangian
tagline: Plain projected gradient ascent on the Lagrangian, but the step size scales with the absolute EMA of the constraint violation, capped to [1e-5, 0.1]; cost advantage is clipped before mixing.

key_hyperparams.name: ema_beta
key_hyperparams.role: smoothing factor for constraint violation EMA

key_hyperparams.name: alpha
key_hyperparams.role: scaling on |EMA delta| in adaptive step

init_recovers: naive when alpha=0 and lr_max small; ppo_lag when alpha=0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the ppo_lag baseline's Adam-driven Lagrangian with a manual projected gradient ascent whose learning rate adapts to the EMA of the constraint violation, plus per-batch cost-advantage clipping in the surrogate.

name: Log-PI Lagrangian
tagline: PI controller for the log-multiplier (instead of the raw multiplier), with strict log-space anti-windup bounds; lambda = exp(nu).
init_recovers: PPO-Lag baseline at the equilibrium where the log multiplier is 0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the ppo_lag baseline's linear Adam update with a PI controller acting in *log-space* (so the multiplier is always positive and bounded), with hard log-space anti-windup.

name: Predictive integral barrier
tagline: Lagrangian target is built from current EMA violation, half the upward cost velocity and half the integral; multiplier rises fast and decays slowly toward the target; surrogate uses a one-sided cost-advantage mix.

key_hyperparams.name: lambda_lr
key_hyperparams.role: base step size for rise/decay rates

init_recovers: ppo_lag-like behaviour when predictive/integral terms are 0 and risky=adv_c
diff_from_baseline: Builds a custom predictive-integral controller (not Adam, not PID) that tracks a target made of EMA violation + half cost velocity + half integral, with rise/decay asymmetry, and replaces the standard cost-advantage mix with a centered, scaled, one-sided risky combination.

name: Adaptive PID with cost-EMA + scale-balanced advantage
tagline: PID controller on EMA cost with violation-proportional kp and asymmetric integral; surrogate rescales adv_c to match adv_r magnitude before mixing.

key_hyperparams.name: integral_decay_step
key_hyperparams.role: integral release per epoch when below limit

diff_from_baseline: Modifies the pid_lag baseline by running PID on a smoothed cost EMA, scaling kp with the relative violation, asymmetric integral release, and—critically—rescaling the cost advantage to the magnitude of the reward advantage before mixing in the surrogate.
